english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something funny or intentionally comic.

exampleSentences.english: That stand-up routine is really amusing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰套棟篤笑真係好搞笑。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 tou3 dung6 duk1 siu3 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something or someone funny and likely to make people laugh.
Use this as the everyday choice for someone or something intentionally funny and entertaining.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 jin2 jyun4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3

english.note: Use 搞笑 when entertaining mainly means funny or likely to make people laugh.

exampleSentences.english: The story he told was really entertaining and made us laugh until our stomachs hurt.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢講嗰個故仔真係搞笑，搞到我哋笑到肚痛。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 go3 gu2 zai2 zan1 hai6 gaau2 siu3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 siu3 dou3 tou5 tung3

english.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on being funny or clownish rather than simply strange.

exampleSentences.english: As soon as Ming got on stage, he got zany and the whole audience could not stop laughing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 阿明一上台就搞笑，成班觀眾笑到停唔到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jat1 soeng5 toi1 zau6 gaau2 siu3 sing4 baan1 gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou3

english.note: Use this when playful means funny, joking, or deliberately amusing rather than fond of games.

exampleSentences.english: You’re really playful and always imitate celebrities.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係好搞笑，成日扮明星。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3 seng4 jat6 baan6 ming4 sing1

english.note: Use this when something is absurd or ridiculous in an amusing or sarcastic way, as in “That’s priceless.”

exampleSentences.english: The way you imitated him was priceless.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 baan6 dou3 gam3 ci5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 siu3

english.note: Use this for a joke or other thing that is funny and makes people laugh.

exampleSentences.english: You're really merry—you had everyone laughing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係好搞笑，成班人都笑晒。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaau2 siu3 seng4 baan1 jan4 dou1 siu3 saai3
